what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Mozambique by conflict and violence, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR and shown side by side.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 465259 people in internal displacement, and UNHCR counted 461745.
Very few refugees from Mozambique remain abroad today.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Mozambique from 2019 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government in several years, with Renamo, ASWJ and, in 2025, Naparama.
Floods and storms are the disasters recorded for Mozambique in IDMC's data.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2024, after big changes between 2018 and 2020.
IDMC's figure peaked at 1029857 in 2022 and fell to 465259 by 2025.
IDMC recorded the most new displacements from conflict in 2020.

how.text: In 2025 IDMC counts 3514 more internally displaced people than UNHCR; the figures overlap and are never added.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice in a year is counted twice.
The sources don't say where inside Mozambique people moved to.
